areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Indirect relation: home ownership for older people and low-income families frees income from rent, supporting social inclusion and protection.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Direct impact encouraging sustainable housing and reducing the urban housing deficit; moderate impact because the programme covers only the housing sector.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: Insufficient relation: no indicators or products directly tied to the area; income effect of home ownership is already credited under human rights.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Products and indicators exist, but sports and leisure access is restricted to the supported housing developments, so impact on the area is not relevant enough.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Insufficient relation: environmental criteria in housing policy are already credited under sustainable cities; no products or indicators directly tied to the area.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Insufficient relation: no products aimed at reducing regional inequality and no regionalized impact indicators.
